body:
Improve the direction agents get so their work stays maintainable, in the work and review briefs (`board.rs::brief`) and `reference.txt`.

### Work runs

- Reuse existing code before adding new code. Extract common patterns
- Prefer small, stateless, self-documenting functions
- Keep modules and functions small and focused; separate concerns by domain and component
- Use clear names for new symbols
- Never allow thoughts/decisions/directives into code comments or UI
- Never allow details/decisions of implementation/development into the UI
- Follow the module boundaries the refactor (task:2414798176c466e4) creates: new code goes in the module that owns its concern

### Review runs

- Flag duplication and large modules; minor ones file as tech debt
- Never allow thoughts/decisions/directives into code comments or UI
- Never allow details/decisions of implementation/development into the UI
- Do not allow cross-domain concerns into the same module
- Flag excessively long functions and dead code as tech debt

### Notes

Overlaps with task:65a103e60528001a (briefs: built-in engineering practices) under feature:09e09be4b9fddd05 — the human may want to merge the two wordings into one task.
title: briefs: direction for maintainable code
